method: Read-only independent source review; this artifact is not an additional experiment or a replacement for raw evidence replay.
reviewed_contracts: Every raw receipt is read from the archive with its recorded SHA-256 verified.
Initial unique anonymous or exact-offset devDAX RAM mapping anchors each VMM incarnation; later split VMAs retain full 512 MiB coverage.
Actual executable digest and environment are bound to each mapped process; disabled/stock arms exclude FC_* variables.
Current guest file-cache ranges cover every distinct offset in 160 MiB and join exactly to scanner GPA/HVA input and present non-swapped visible actual PFNs.
Per-scan pause acknowledges after cache pin; three-VM group scans occur within a common paused interval.
Samples bind before/recycle address sets, exact raw PFN changes, operation order, guest identity/private state and two distinct peers.
Independent boots and exact machine/block/kernel/initrd API settings distinguish primary arms from snapshot clones.
Guest hot/cold timing, complete payload/churn oracle, host prewarming and recorded KSM/THP settings are checked.
Pooled samples retain at least 128 MiB of the initially proven common PFNs; final canonical full comparison binds image identity and canonical offset.
Control timing is labeled experimental admission/evidence transport, not migration or direct-handoff latency.
Suite validates shared fixture/source hashes; stock snapshot proof is independently replayed by verify_stock_snapshot.py.
interpretation_limits: Raw recorded evidence checks cannot certify arbitrary malicious measurement code or prove production deployment properties.
Fifteen sequential samples within one run are repeated workload observations, not independent hardware trials.
PFN equality is measured inside one L1 host; reserved devDAX backing is not reclaimed, so data-frame aliasing is not a net-capacity result.
QEMU-backed CXL topology does not reproduce physical CXL latency or validate noncoherent hardware.
Private-write measurements overwrite existing private mappings; recycle combines eviction/allocation/fill/verification and does not isolate first-write CoW latency.
Stock same-snapshot clones can share clean pages despite separately booted stock guests using separate cache frames.
